fields.default: Warunk WOW was a coffee stop by day and a small club at night. The staff and regulars made it feel like a second home.

fields.label: It was about a five-minute walk from my hotel in Bali. Most of the students I knew had barely heard
fields.default: It was about a five-minute walk from my hotel in Bali. Most of the students I knew had barely heard of it, so it felt separate from the familiar visitor checklist. I could stop there for coffee or lunch during the day and return to a completely different atmosphere upstairs in the evening, with a local DJ or a band.

fields.label: I ended up going almost daily. The important change was not finding something new on every visit; it
fields.default: I ended up going almost daily. The important change was not finding something new on every visit; it was becoming familiar with the place. I got to know the staff and the regulars, and gradually became a familiar face myself. A stop on the way back to the hotel turned into part of the rhythm of my stay.

fields.default: That is why this small place has its own Field Note. When I think about those three months, the best memories are not all attached to a beach or a famous viewpoint. Some belong to a room I returned to often, where the people made an ordinary evening feel personal.
